notes: The 1989 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: master plans (Marina, McLaren, Randall), the Kezar rebuilding design, a mural dedication and contracts.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Candlestick Park field named for Bill Walsh in football configuration (Res. 15340; no page), the Juana Briones plaque appeal for Washington Square (denied), the zoo sound berm for the Oceanside Treatment Plant, a police koban in Union Square.

findings.description: A ceramic tile mural made at the Boeddeker Recreation Center over nine months of weekly classes by the artist Johanna Poethig and Tenderloin children, funded through the Arts Commission's Arts in Public Places Program, was dedicated on January 14, 1989.

findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the schematic design for rebuilding Kezar Stadium after its demolition, due to begin in March: a football and soccer field with an all-weather track open to the community daily, a promenade around it, a landscaped buffer and about 10,000 seats.
